name: Sun Cleric: Sunslam fulfills a Vow on each of its four ticks, not just once (#9148)
contract: Sunslam 805629 channels for 4 seconds, triggering its melee-class damage spell 805639 once per second (4
ticks total). AscensionSunCleric::Fulfill() gated the once-per-cast 807441 flag on the Origin()-translated
Spell*, which for 805639 is always the same shared channeled Spell* object (Origin() redirects every tick
back to the channel): the first tick fulfilled a Vow and set the flag, so the remaining three ticks of the
same channel silently found it already set and bailed out. Fulfilling a Vow while Trial of Valor (805581) is
active reduces Horusath Blast's (500154) cooldown by Amount(807445) ms, an externally observable side effect:
with the fix each of the four Sunslam ticks must fulfill the active Vow of the Valkyr (807749) independently,
reducing Horusath Blast's cooldown four times, not once.

steps.label: Let login and class synchronisation settle
Vow of the Valkyr is active
Vow of the Valkyr and Horusath Blast share StartRecoveryCategory 133 (1000 ms); let that GCD clear
Trial of Valor's passive is active
Fixture: Dawn requires 20 Solar Power (500149) to cast
Fixture: Dawn's own CasterAuraSpell readiness marker
Horusath Blast lands and starts its cooldown
Horusath Blast cooldown before the Sunslam channel
Horusath Blast and Sunslam share StartRecoveryCategory 133 (1500 ms); let that GCD clear
Let the full 4-tick Sunslam channel complete
DISCRIMINATING: four Vow fulfillments reduce Horusath Blast's cooldown far more than one would
